vocabulary.capacity_policy: A reported, event- or layout-specific number with year and spatial boundary; never inferred from area.
vocabulary.annual_visitation_policy: Square-level operator counts only; distinguish visits, unique people and museum admissions. Missing is null, never zero.
vocabulary.weekday_holiday_policy: Qualitative paired programme comparison unless a matched count series is available. No invented peak multiplier.
vocabulary.population_policy: Municipal/LGA scope, reference date and registry/ERP method stated; metropolitan figures separate.
vocabulary.coverage_policy: Metric union of footprint polygons clipped to a 600m square; denominator includes water; source epoch and semantics retained.

Spatial form

Piazza, arcades and Piazzetta form a legible sequence from enclosure to waterfront.

Public transport

Waterbus plus walking is the principal approach, not direct car access.

Landscape integration

Commercial edges

label: 气候适应
Climate response
text: 夏季日晒与湿热、降雨及异常高潮位影响使用；覆盖边缘和预警是主要应对。
Summer sun and humidity, rain and high tides affect use; covered edges and warnings provide responses.

label: 使用功能
Use programme
text: 穿行／停留／文化参观／公共活动四类功能并存。
Passage / staying / cultural visits / public events coexist.

Ordinary / holiday use

Ordinary days emphasise visits, walking and terraces; Carnival events can impose entry and capacity limits.

Community / tourism

title: 连续柱廊
Continuous arcades
text: 把建筑立面转化为有遮蔽、可穿行的公共边缘。
Turns building fronts into covered, walkable public edges.

title: 广场—水岸序列
Square–waterfront sequence

Moves from enclosed Piazza through Piazzetta to lagoon with both direction and variety.

title: 仪式与日常共用
Ritual and everyday sharing
text: 同一公共地面容纳日常穿行、文化参观及城市仪式。
One civic ground supports daily passage, cultural visits and civic ritual.

Concerts and outdoor opera

Ticketed attendance, not unrestricted all-day access

Orchestra, chorus and soloists turn the square into an open-air theatre.

Temporary stage and chair rows establish a viewing direction and occupy normally open ground.

name: 步行、相会与水岸停留
Walking, meeting and waterfront staying

Ordinary non-event days

Cross Piazza and Piazzetta to the lagoon, choosing places to stop along arcades and waterfront.

Carnevale: opening and costumed performance

Documented example: 2025 Carnival opening

Watch stage and costume events; participation follows that edition’s organiser

Performance, music and masks transform everyday civic ground into a festive gathering place.
spatial_change: 舞台、灯光、站立观众及入口管理改变广场的使用方向。
Stage, lighting, standing spectators and managed entrances change how the square is used.

when: Documented example: 4 Mar 2025

Watch the public presentation; candidate selection is a separate process
text: 年度Maria与同伴在圣马可广场向公众亮相，连接城市传统与当代庆典。
The annual Maria and companions appear before the public, connecting civic tradition and contemporary celebration.
spatial_change: 仪式在舞台集中，观众在建筑界面前聚集；与开幕同属狂欢节。
Ceremony focuses on a stage, with spectators gathering before the facades; this is part of Carnival.

name: San Geminiano拆除与拿破仑翼重建
San Geminiano removed; the Napoleonic Wing built
text: 西端从教堂端景转为延续两侧柱廊的建筑界面，改变今日广场的围合方式。
A church frontage became an edge continuing the arcades, changing the square’s enclosure.

The collapse removed the square’s principal vertical landmark; its reconstruction became a question of civic memory.

name: 重建钟楼揭幕典礼
Inauguration of the rebuilt campanile
text: 新钟楼在圣马可节举行揭幕，延续“原样原址”的城市形象。
The rebuilt tower was inaugurated on St Mark’s Day, restoring its familiar form and location.

Exceptional high tide

The municipal record is 194 cm: a city tide-datum reading, not water depth at every point in the square.

name: 2025狂欢节在广场开幕
2025 Carnival opening in the square
text: 开幕表演、灯光与公众聚集把广场西端改成节庆舞台。

name: La Fenice《乡村骑士》音乐会版
La Fenice’s Cavalleria rusticana in concert
text: 乐团、合唱与独唱共同使用临时舞台；售票座席改变普通日的自由停留。

Dining and terraces occupy edges while the centre supports informal stay and civic events.

label: 气候适应

Technology

Continuity of civic ritual
text: Palio将地方社区和公共地面持续联系起来。

Palio di Provenzano

One of the annual focal points of competition and identity among Siena’s Contrade.

Palio dell’Assunta

Attendance follows that edition’s entrances, grandstands and safety arrangements

The other regular Palio also centres on civic communities rather than being simply a tourist show.

Official Liberation Day ceremony
text: 广场举行公共纪念仪式，证明它也是市政典礼与公共记忆的场所。
An official ceremony used the square as a setting for civic commemoration and public memory.

Concerto per l’Italia

Ordinary / holiday use
text: 普通日自由到访与社区课程，节庆／比赛日形成舞台、屏幕和临时围合。
Ordinary visits and community classes shift to stages, screens and temporary enclosures on celebration and sport days.

label: 容量与年到访量
Capacity & annual visitation
text: Main Square公布10,000人容量；2025–26年到访1,190万以上、389场活动，口径分别保留。
Main Square lists 10,000 capacity; FY2025–26 reports 11.9m+ visitors and 389 events, with scopes kept separate.

label: 科技接入
Technology
text: 场地页列65 m² Digital Façade、音响及听力辅助；另有Labyrinth与环境监测系统。
Venue lists a 65 m² Digital Façade, sound and hearing support, alongside Labyrinth and environmental monitoring.

label: 服务对象
Community / tourism
text: 2025–26支持114个社区组织；同时承接都市文化参观与游客，不能只写成旅游景点。
114 community organisations supported in FY2025–26, alongside cultural visitors and tourists; more than a tourism attraction.

title: 基础设施上的公共地面
Civic ground over infrastructure
text: 通过铁路上盖与坡地，把原本分隔的城市关系重新连接。
Deck and slope reconnect urban relationships separated by rail.

title: 室内外互补
Indoor/outdoor complement
text: Atrium为露天广场补充覆盖空间与文化入口。
Atrium supplements the outdoor plaza with cover and cultural entrances.

title: 文化与数字活动平台
Cultural and digital platform
text: 文化机构、数字屏幕与全年活动支持社区和游客共同使用。
Institutions, screen and year-round programming support both communities and visitors.

name: 露天电影与共同观看
Outdoor cinema and collective viewing
when: 已记录实例：2026-11-04，《Pellegrini’s: A Melbourne Legacy》
Documented example: 4 Nov 2026, Pellegrini’s: A Melbourne Legacy
access: 该场官方标注免费；图为屏幕设施，不是该场次照片
This screening was officially listed as free; image shows the screen infrastructure, not that session
text: 通过大屏幕一起观看本地文化纪录片，使路过者也能加入。
The Big Screen brings people together for a documentary about local culture, including passing visitors.
spatial_change: 屏幕建立共同朝向，坡面和台阶成为面向屏幕的停留地带。
The screen creates a shared orientation; slope and steps support staying and watching.

name: 公共集会与城市表达
Civic assembly and public expression
when: 历史实例：2003年和平集会
Historical example: the 2003 peace rally
access: 历史照片记录公开集会；当前活动安排依场地规则
An archival example of public gathering; current events follow venue arrangements
text: 广场可以承载政治与社会表达，而不仅是消费或文化参观。
The square has hosted political and social expression alongside commerce and cultural visits.
spatial_change: 人群填入开放地面，建筑边缘成为集会的共同背景。
People occupy the open ground, with architectural edges forming the setting for assembly.

name: Victorian Festival of Diwali
Victorian Festival of Diwali
when: Documented edition: 31 Oct 2026
access: 主办方标注免费；Celebrate India Inc.主办
Listed as free; presented by Celebrate India Inc.
text: 舞蹈、音乐与节庆活动让不同社区在城市中心共同庆祝。
Dance, music and festivities bring communities together in the city centre.
spatial_change: Main Square、河岸步道与The Edge共同组成活动场地。
Main Square, the riverside walk and The Edge form the event setting.

name: Polish Festival @ Fed Square
Polish Festival @ Fed Square
when: Documented edition: 16 Nov 2025
access: 免费、家庭友好；展示波兰社区文化
Free and family friendly; a celebration of Polish community culture
text: 舞台表演、传统舞蹈与社区展示把文化庆典带入公共地面。
Stage performances, traditional dance and community displays occupy the civic ground.
spatial_change: 舞台是观看焦点，其他公共空间承担逛游、相会与社区交流。
The stage anchors viewing, while adjacent spaces support browsing, meeting and exchange.

name: Fed Square向公众开放
Fed Square opens to the public
text: 铁路上盖的公共地面成为墨尔本的新城市集会场所。
Civic ground over the railway opened as a new gathering place for Melbourne.

name: 和平集会
Peace rally
text: 州立图书馆图像记录广场内的和平集会：公共空间也承载政治与社会表达。
State Library imagery records a peace rally inside the square, showing a civic role beyond entertainment and consumption.

name: 全国道歉的公共转播观看
Collective viewing of the National Apology
text: 人们在广场大屏幕前观看对被偷走的一代的全国道歉；典礼本身在堪培拉，广场是共同观看点。
People gathered at the Big Screen for the National Apology to the Stolen Generations. The ceremony took place in Canberra; the square was a collective viewing site.

name: Solar Equation：Light in Winter互动公共艺术
Solar Equation: interactive art for The Light in Winter
text: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer的装置把模拟太阳悬于广场上方，公众可通过互动设备影响显示。
Rafael Lozano-Hemmer’s installation suspended a simulated sun over the square, with public interaction affecting its display.

name: Polish Festival
Polish Festival
text: 波兰社区以舞蹈、音乐与文化展示在广场举办免费家庭节庆。
The Polish community hosted a free family festival of dance, music and cultural displays.

name: Victorian Festival of Diwali
Victorian Festival of Diwali
text: Celebrate India主办的免费节庆使用Main Square、河岸步道与The Edge。
Celebrate India’s free festival used Main Square, the riverside walk and The Edge.
